name: Machine Lieutenant
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The machine lieutenant has
advantage on saving throws against spells and
other magical effects.

traits.name: Both Guard and Ward
traits.text:
While the lieutenant is
within 5 feet of the attuned owner of the codex
automata, any attack targeting the codex’s
owner has a 50% chance to instead target the
machine lieutenant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The lieutenant makes two
longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit,
reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing
damage or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used
with two hands.
